vn30_is_ato.name: VN30 ATO Session
vn30_is_ato.comment: True during VN30F1M ATO opening call auction (08:45-09:00)

vn30_is_atc.name: VN30 ATC Session
vn30_is_atc.comment: True during VN30F1M ATC closing call auction (14:30-14:45)

vn30_session_morning.name: VN30 Morning Session
vn30_session_morning.comment: True during VN30F1M morning trading session (08:45-11:30)

vn30_session_afternoon.name: VN30 Afternoon Session
vn30_session_afternoon.comment: True during VN30F1M afternoon trading session (13:00-14:45)

vn30_pre_market_lead.name: VN30 Pre-Market Lead Window
vn30_pre_market_lead.comment: True when VN30F1M trades before underlying spot market open (08:45-09:00)

vn30_session_0930_1335.name: VN30 Session 09:30-13:35
vn30_session_0930_1335.comment: True when time_int is between 09:30 and 13:35 inclusive

vn30_session_0935_1425.name: VN30 Session 09:35-14:25
vn30_session_0935_1425.comment: True when time_int is between 09:35 inclusive and 14:25 exclusive

vn30_session_0935_1335.name: VN30 Session 09:35-13:35
vn30_session_0935_1335.comment: True when time_int is between 09:35 and 13:35 inclusive

vn30_entry_window_1300_1425.name: VN30 Entry Window 13:00-14:25
vn30_entry_window_1300_1425.comment: True when time_int is between 13:00 and 14:25 inclusive

vn30_session_progress.name: VN30 Session Progress
vn30_session_progress.comment: Normalized progression of VN30F1M daily trading hours (0.0 to 1.0)

vn30_is_expiration_day.name: VN30 Expiration Day
vn30_is_expiration_day.comment: True if trade date is the 3rd Thursday of the month (VN30F1M contract settlement day)

vn30_is_expiration_week.name: VN30 Expiration Week
vn30_is_expiration_week.comment: True if current trading week contains the VN30F1M contract expiration day

vn30_is_expiry_settlement_window.name: VN30 Expiry Settlement Window
vn30_is_expiry_settlement_window.comment: True during the settlement price calculation window (14:00-14:45) on expiration day

vn30_days_to_expiration.name: VN30 Days to Expiration
vn30_days_to_expiration.comment: Number of calendar days remaining until current monthly contract expiration

vn30_opening_gap.name: VN30 Opening Gap Ratio
vn30_opening_gap.comment: Percentage gap between session open price and previous day close price

vn30_orb_15m_high.name: VN30 15-Min ORB High
vn30_orb_15m_high.comment: High price of the first 15 minutes of the trading session

vn30_orb_15m_low.name: VN30 15-Min ORB Low
vn30_orb_15m_low.comment: Low price of the first 15 minutes of the trading session

vn30_orb_15m_range.name: VN30 15-Min ORB Range
vn30_orb_15m_range.comment: Range (High - Low) of the first 15 minutes of the trading session

vn30_orb_15m_breakout.name: VN30 15-Min ORB Breakout
vn30_orb_15m_breakout.comment: 1 if close breaks above 15m ORB high, -1 if below 15m ORB low, 0 otherwise

vn30_orb_30m_high.name: VN30 30-Min ORB High
vn30_orb_30m_high.comment: High price of the first 30 minutes of the trading session

vn30_orb_30m_low.name: VN30 30-Min ORB Low
vn30_orb_30m_low.comment: Low price of the first 30 minutes of the trading session

vn30_orb_30m_range.name: VN30 30-Min ORB Range
vn30_orb_30m_range.comment: Range (High - Low) of the first 30 minutes of the trading session

vn30_orb_30m_breakout.name: VN30 30-Min ORB Breakout
vn30_orb_30m_breakout.comment: 1 if close breaks above 30m ORB high, -1 if below 30m ORB low, 0 otherwise

first_close_0915.name: First Close 09:15
first_close_0915.comment: First Close value at 09:15 for the current trading day

pre_1345_high.name: Pre 13:45 High
pre_1345_high.comment: Maximum High before 13:45 for the current trading day

pre_1355_low.name: Pre 13:55 Low
pre_1355_low.comment: Minimum Low before 13:55 for the current trading day

prev_day_1445_close.name: Previous Day 14:45 Close
prev_day_1445_close.comment: Previous trading day's 14:45 close, falling back to previous completed close

morning_high.name: Morning High
morning_high.comment: Current trading day's High through time_int <= 1100

morning_low.name: Morning Low
morning_low.comment: Current trading day's Low through time_int <= 1100

vn30_late_session_range_pos.name: VN30 Late Session Range Position
vn30_late_session_range_pos.comment: Position of current close within session cumulative low-high range (0.0 to 1.0)
